title: V3 stage-oriented refactor P2.8 negative control — required check bypasses the trusted base runner (do not merge)
goal: Show on a real pull request that a workflow in which a required check runs the head dispatcher in place instead of the base runner fails the CI activation contract after CP04d declared trusted execution active.
acceptanceCriteria: The base CI contract in Validate fails v3-architecture and both v3-cross-platform checks with trusted-base-runner and trusted-base-no-head-dispatcher for v3-historical-integrity; the pull request is closed without merging.
